description: Compteurs à budgets actifs de WalStat is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by IWEPS WalStat. Les compteurs à budget sont des compteurs pour l’énergie (électricité et gaz) qui fonctionnent selon un mode de prépaiement avec carte. Le client doit recharger la carte de son compteur à budget avant d’utiliser l’énergie. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Administration et Services publics, Tourisme, Culture, Sport et Loisirs. Its keywords are niveau, condition, vie, énergie, précarité, statistiques. The portal shows 287 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons - CC0 (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
